readings.core: Each update halves the current scalar. For a value in [0,1], halving preserves nonnegativity and cannot exceed one, so repeated updates remain in that interval.
readings.scope: The invariant requires initialization in [0,1] and concerns the exact arithmetic rule. Ten updates from 0.8 illustrate, but do not establish the claim for arbitrary starts: three becomes 1.5. An inexact-arithmetic guarantee is not recoverable.
readings.core_witness: halving preserves nonnegativity and cannot take an iterate above one
readings.scope_witness: That invariant is conditional on the initial value, not a property of arbitrary starts.
readings.unclear: Behavior under inexact arithmetic is not recoverable.

readings.core: Against the baseline, projection reduces optimizer-state storage from 8 to 4 GB while other measured allocations remain 8 GB. Consequently, total training allocation falls from 16 to 12 GB, not by half. Checkpoint losses are 2.3 for projection and 2.2 for the baseline.
readings.scope: Measured quantities are optimizer-state storage, other allocations, total training allocation and checkpoint loss, at batch eight on the same device, model and precision. Savings concern measured state storage, not every training resource. Quality equivalence and another batch size are unestablished.
readings.core_witness: Total training allocation consequently falls from 16 to 12 GB, not by half,
readings.scope_witness: it does not establish quality equivalence or characterize another batch size.

readings.core: The policy reaches the final-stage state in 7/10 physical executions versus the baseline's 5/10. Joint all-stage completion is 4/10 versus 3/10. These different success events support different descriptions of the comparison.
readings.scope: Final-state attainment and joint completion were counted under matched starts and time budgets. Three of the policy's seven final-state successes followed an earlier failure and reset, so final-state attainment is not uninterrupted three-stage completion. Small descriptive counts establish neither statistical significance nor general deployment reliability.
readings.core_witness: in seven of ten physical executions, compared with five of ten for the baseline
readings.scope_witness: These small counts are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance or general deployment reliability.
